uncertainties: Marurur's nickname for Subaru rendered Little Rascal, preserving the nickname instead of replacing it with his name.
text:
...
This is your fault!
...!
This unit was put together
from a band of outcasts.
What little discipline we had
held only because
Captain Azlier always
led us to success!
And you ruined that!
You...!
Galeor!!
Ghh...
Never disgrace yourself
by begging the enemy for pity,
even if it costs you your life!
I fell short
as commander...
That is all!
Azlier...
Th-there's trouble!
Big trouble!
Marurur!?
What happened!?
Hey!
L-Little Rascal!
Little Rascal's been...
He's been
captured!
What!?
What did you say!?
Well? What's taking so long?
Bring me that bastard,
or the brat dies!
Ugh...
Subaru!?
Calm yourself,
Panashe!
But Subaru got caught
because he was
protecting me!
It's my fault...
Hic... sob...
Waaaaah!!
Don't cry!
You're older
than me, Panashe!
I'm fine!
Besides...
Once Teacher gets here,
this creep's going
to get what he deserves!
...Hear that?
Well, we'll see, won't we?
Subaru, are you all right!?
Subaru!?
Oh...
Hehehe! Glad you came.
I've been waiting...
How dare you do that
to my little buddy!
Big bro...!
Taking hostages again?
You really haven't
learned any new tricks...
You coward...
Have you no shame!?
Big sis...
Please, you've got
to save Subaru...
Let
Subaru go!
So you were the one
setting fire to the villages.
So you were the one
setting fire to the villages...
Hehehehe...
Well, half of it was me.
Half?
The first fire
